question: In the complete months (Jan 2017 to Aug 2018), find the month with the biggest month-over-month revenue drop. Which product category (English name) had the largest revenue decrease that month compared with the previous month?
sql:
WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS month,
        ct.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi USING (order_id)
    JOIN products p USING (product_id)
    JOIN category_translation ct USING (product_category_name)
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  '2018-09-01'  -- up to Aug 2018 inclusive
    GROUP BY month, ct.product_category_name_english
),
month_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        cur.month,
        cur.product_category_name_english,
        cur.revenue,
        LAG(cur.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY cur.product_category_name_english ORDER BY cur.month) AS prev_revenue,
        cur.revenue - LAG(cur.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY cur.product_category_name_english ORDER BY cur.month) AS diff
    FROM monthly_revenue cur
),
overall_month_drop AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(diff) AS total_diff
    FROM month_diff
    GROUP BY month
    HAVING total_diff IS NOT NULL
),
worst_month AS (
    SELECT month
    FROM overall_month_drop
    ORDER BY total_diff ASC  -- most negative drop
    LIMIT 1
),
category_drop_in_worst_month AS (
    SELECT 
        md.product_category_name_english,
        md.diff
    FROM month_diff md
    JOIN worst_month wm ON md.month = wm.month
    WHERE md.diff IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY md.diff ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    wm.month AS month,
    cdw.product_category_name_english AS category_with_largest_drop,
    cdw.diff AS revenue_drop
FROM worst_month wm
JOIN category_drop_in_worst_month cdw ON TRUE
